rationale: P characterises whether required braking occurs, which is directly necessary to evaluate prevention of omitted braking under SG-1. FR-7 establishes braking itself as the required system response, and H-1 supports the declared operational situation and collision context. P does not extend into sensing, planning algorithms, communication, or mechanism-specific timing merely because they influence braking.
determining_elements: “Whether the vehicle executes a braking maneuver” identifies execution versus omission of the behaviour targeted by T.
“When braking is required to avoid a collision” ties that behaviour to the condition establishing its necessity.
The road, speed, weather, and pedestrian-crossing conditions match the operational situation declared in H-1; road users and static obstacles appear in its hazardous event.
The scope’s “decide and perform braking” remains a high-level description of the required braking response rather than adding internal decision-making mechanisms.
